evidence: No semantic name proposed: the callable wrapper at decompiled/main/main_0026.c:136-140 enters the PC-resumable implementation fb_700032fd94; its lifted body spans :146-8562 and performs a large multi-path routine with many direct callees, so the available entry/caller excerpts do not isolate one behavior. Indexed callers pass the object plus additional arguments at decompiled/main/main_0027.c:3533-3537 and :5081-5084. The queue's pitch-flight helper lead is not enough to identify this routine's own behavior.

The body clears the record status/result at object+0x134, derives an index from the nested value at object+0x70, and conditionally calls status/attribute helpers before storing a resulting value back to +0x134 (decompiled/main/main_0053.c:23494-23515, :23521-23545). Its indexed caller is prepare_rtts_training_focus_offer_record and invokes it on the record at decompiled/main/main_0053.c:22720-22723. The label is limited to the observed status update in that caller's training-focus offer preparation.

The body obtains two lookup outputs, tests their returned flags and small integer values, then conditionally passes the resulting pair to another helper; the exact record purpose and result semantics are not exposed by this body (decompiled/main/main_0054.c:24945-24954, :24955-24983, :24989-25010). Its caller f_7000708cf4 invokes it with a single record argument and consumes the returned x0 at decompiled/main/main_0054.c:24927-24931. Neighboring waiver and strided-record helper names are leads only, so no semantic rename is justified.

The body derives and updates candidate-selection bytes at object offsets +0x3c0 and +0x3c2, uses the attribute-context status to choose the update path, reads the selected stat index at +0x3c1, and passes the object/index/condition to dispatch_ranked_stat_candidate_generation (decompiled/main/main_0087.c:49535-49552, :49553-49583, :49585-49595). Its indexed caller enters this continuation with the same object and preserved state at decompiled/main/main_0087.c:49519-49522. This names the observed candidate-state update without claiming meanings for the individual bytes.

The body rejects an unset object flag at +0x42a, rejects context status values 6 and 7, requires a nested provider, then reads player attribute 9 and a halfword from the provider and returns success only when their sum equals 1; failure returns 0xfffffffe (decompiled/main/main_0119.c:10080-10096, :10102-10121, :10126-10134). The indexed caller stores that result for its own conditional path at decompiled/main/main_0118.c:3242-3246. The name describes the observed validation while leaving the opaque context/attribute semantics unspecified.
